# Rod banks
Each Control Rod Channel belongs to one of four banks (A to D; wrench it to change). Banks drive in from the top. Move them with the GUI's − / + buttons (shift for 10%), by redstone or through the machine control API (bank_a to bank_d, 0 to 100%).
- Redstone that tells the reactor to stop SCRAMs it.
- With Redstone drives rods on, a signal holds every bank at least signal/15 in.
- Switched off through the API, every bank drives all the way in.

# Protection
Trip points, each switched on or off and set on the Protection page: high power, short period, high fuel temperature, high pressure and low coolant flow. A trip SCRAMs the reactor: every rod falls in within two seconds. The SCRAM button does the same. RESET clears a trip once its cause has gone; the rods stay in.
If the cladding fails the reactor SCRAMs for good; if the fuel melts, every rod in the core is ruined.

# Radiation
A running core is a strong source through its vessel, and spent rods are worse. Build shielding round it: concrete, lead and water.
